spans.s:
अशेष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं)
 1. Entire, all the whole.
 2. Infinite, endless.
 E. अ
neg. and शेष remainder.

अशेषतस् ind. Entirely, wholly.
 E. अशेष whole, तसि aff.

असेचनक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Charming, lovely.
 E. अ neg. सेचन satisfaction.

आसेचनक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) See the preceding.
 E. आङ् before षिच् to
sprinkle, ल्युट् and कन् affs. also असेचनक.

असेवन n. (-नं)
 1. Disregarding, neglecting.
 2. Avoiding, shunning.
 3.
Disobedience, inattention.
 E. अ neg. सेवन service.

असेवा f. (-वा)
 1. Avoiding, not following or practising.
 2.

.
Disobedience.
 E. अ neg. सेवा service: see the last.

असेवित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
 1. Neglected, unattended to, disobeyed.
 2. Ab-
stained from, disused.
 E. अ neg. सेवित served, used.

असेव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
 1. Not to be served or attended to.
 2. Not to be
used or practised, not to be eaten, drank, &c.
 E. अ neg. सेव्य to be
followed.

आसेक m. (-कः) Sprinkling.
 E. आङ् before षिच् to sprinkle, affix घञ्.

आसेचन n. (-नं) Sprinkling.
 mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Beloved, desired.
 E. आङ्
before षिच् to sprinkle, ल्युट् affix; also असेचनक.

आसेद्धृ m. (-द्धा) One who confines or arrests another.
 E. आङ् before षिध्
to go, and तृच् aff.

आसेध m. (-धः) Arrest, legal restraint of four kinds; कालासेधः limit of
time, स्थानासेधः confinement to a place, प्रवासासेधः prohibition
against removal or departure, कर्म्मासेधः restriction from employment.
E. आङ् before षिध् to go, घञ् aff.

आसेध्य mfn. (-ध्यः-ध्या-ध्यं) To be interrupted, prohibited or restrained. E.
आङ् before षिध् to go, यत् aff.
